verdict: Ads remain off; local actions are slipping, but your site holds steady.
narrative: No paid advertising has run since August 1st — zero spend across Meta and Google for the full 28-day window. Without that support, Google Business Profile actions dropped 39.85% week over week, with the last few days showing near-zero local engagement. On the other side, your website is pulling on its own: GA4 sessions are up 23.18% week over week and holding close to the 28-day average, which tells us organic interest in Billy Doe Meats is real and intact. Ad creative from the live-cooking shoot is being finalized this week, with paid campaigns targeted to restart by August 31st alongside funnel and tracking work that is already in motion.
